note: No queryable zoning district service found for Le Flore County (FIPS 40079) or its cities. ArcGIS searches for zoning returned nothing for Le Flore, Poteau, Sallisaw or Oklahoma; the county's LeFlore_County_Data service (twoody_uok) holds only transportation, legislative, municipal boundary and hydrology layers. Poteau's code (Chapter 3, Zoning Districts; Map) refers to a zoning map but links no GIS service or file. Zoning fields appear only in paid parcel vendor data (Dynamo Spatial) and an assessor lookup (datacrosspoint), not in public district polygons.
